items.title: END OF TERM 2 BREAK
items.body:
We thank God for the blessings and strength He has given us to come to the end of term 2 2026. 
we expect the students back on  MONDAY 24/8/2026

ENJOY YOUR HOLIDAY 🙏🏾🙏🏾

items.title: Term 1 Opening Day
items.body: All students report on 6th January 2026. Come with your admission letter, bank slip, and all required personal items. Reporting starts at 8:00 AM.
